evidence.title: AnimatiSS - A nice, colorful collection of CSS animations for your projects

name: AnimatiSS
summary: Collection of CSS animations you preview live and copy the keyframe code from — scale, rotate, slide, shadow, blur, shake and more.
description: A preview gallery of CSS animations, grouped by effect: scale up and down, rotate, rotate and scale, swing, slide, shadow, tracking in/out, blur and special. Click any style — for example scale-up-center or shadow-drop-top-left — to see it run and grab its CSS code for your own project.
contains: preview gallery of CSS keyframe animations
effect groups: scale, rotate, swing, slide, shadow, tracking, blur, special
click a style to copy its CSS code
